money.no-tables: Prices, costs and payment rates exist only for fields in Iowa and Poland.
money.no-economics: No sourced yield, price or direct costs for {crop}, so income is not estimated.
money.condition.us-340: Only if your application is selected: EQIP is competitive. NRCS pays this rate per acre in each contract year with a cover crop. Spread over the years of this rotation.
money.condition.us-328: Only if your application is selected: EQIP is competitive. NRCS pays this rate per acre for a planned rotation of at least two annual crops that replaces your current one.
money.condition.pl-cover-crop: Eco-scheme points for a winter cover crop mix of at least two species, sown 1 July to 1 October and kept until 15 February, or a small-seeded legume undersown in the main crop. Mustard or phacelia sown alone do not count. Spread over the years of this rotation that have a cover crop.
money.condition.pl-crop-diversity: Eco-scheme points for a diverse crop structure. ARiMR checks the whole farm: at least three crops, the largest at most 65% of arable land, listed legumes at least 20%, cereals at most 65%, beet and potato at most 30%. This rotation meets the same shares over its years.
money.condition.pl-straw: Eco-scheme point for chopping all the straw after harvest and mixing it into the soil or ploughing it in. Counted in the years with a cereal, maize, oilseed or legume grain crop.
money.condition.pl-gaec7: GAEC 7 crop rotation rule for farms with more than 10 ha of arable land.
money.condition.pl-gaec7-pass: GAEC 7 crop rotation rule, for farms with more than 10 ha of arable land: no crop stays on this field more than 3 years in a row. This rotation passes. The farm-wide rule that 40% of arable land changes crop every year is not checked here.
money.condition.pl-gaec7-fail: GAEC 7 crop rotation rule, for farms with more than 10 ha of arable land: {crop} stays on this field {years} years in a row, and 3 is the limit unless a cover crop follows it. Breaking the rule can cut the farm's area payments.
money.condition.pl-gaec7-fail-every: GAEC 7 crop rotation rule, for farms with more than 10 ha of arable land: {crop} is grown every year with no cover crop after it, and 3 years in a row is the limit. Breaking the rule can cut the farm's area payments.
